classification.difficultyReason: Combine the sector-area and arc-length equations to determine two unknowns exactly.

content.prompt:
The area of a sector is $\frac{3\pi}{10}\text{ cm}^2$ and the arc length cut off by the sector is $\frac{\pi}{5}\text{ cm}$.

Find the exact value of $r$ and $\theta$.

answer.worked:
Using $l=r\theta$ and $A=\frac12r^2\theta$:
$$\begin{align*}r\theta&=\frac{\pi}{5}\\\frac12r^2\theta&=\frac{3\pi}{10}.\end{align*}$$
Substitute $r\theta=\frac{\pi}{5}$ into the area equation:
$$\begin{align*}\frac12r\left(\frac{\pi}{5}\right)&=\frac{3\pi}{10}\\\frac{r\pi}{10}&=\frac{3\pi}{10}\\r&=3\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
Then substitute into the arc-length equation:
$$\begin{align*}3\theta&=\frac{\pi}{5}\\\theta&=\frac{\pi}{15}\text{ radians}.\end{align*}$$
